# Code of conduct

Everyone participating in Codex Trace discussions, issues, reviews, and other project spaces is expected to help maintain a respectful environment.

- Discuss ideas and behavior with specific evidence. Accept good-faith questions and constructive feedback.
- Respect differences in background, experience, identity, and communication style.
- Do not harass, threaten, insult, or target people. Sexual harassment, discriminatory language, and sustained personal attacks are unacceptable.
- Respect privacy. Do not post another person's contact details, credentials, private conversations, or recordings without permission.
- Keep contributions relevant and avoid spam or repeated disruption.

Maintainers may edit or remove material, close discussions, restrict participation, or ban accounts when needed to protect the community. They should explain actions where doing so does not compromise privacy or safety, consider context, and avoid using enforcement to suppress respectful technical disagreement.

Report concerns privately through a contact method on [the maintainer's GitHub profile](https://github.com/xz1220). If no private method is available, ask for a private channel without posting the incident's sensitive details publicly. For software vulnerabilities, use [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Maintainers will handle reports discreetly where possible; response times are not guaranteed.
